name: Skincaremaxxing

card.summary: Keeping a consistent, optimised skincare routine, usually cleansing, moisturising and sun protection plus targeted actives, to improve skin clarity, texture and tone.
card.note: Over-exfoliation can irritate and damage the skin barrier; persistent skin problems are handled by a dermatologist.

quick.overview:
Skincaremaxxing is the looksmaxxing term for committing to a thorough, consistent skincare routine. Skin quality is a visible part of facial attractiveness, so clearer, more even and better hydrated skin is a way to improve looks without surgery.

Dermatology guidance described by Wikipedia centres on gentle cleansing, moisturising and sun protection, with other products reserved for specific conditions like acne. Forum users also pair skincare with other plans, for example in posts that imagine combining it with jaw surgery.
quick.how: A typical routine is a gentle cleanser, a moisturiser, and sunscreen applied before sun exposure and reapplied after sweating, with extra products such as exfoliants or prescribed acne treatments added for specific goals. Results over time depend on consistency.
quick.risks: Over-exfoliating can cause irritation and barrier damage. Fragranced or unsuitable products can irritate sensitive skin, so patch testing is commonly advised, and persistent or severe problems are usually referred to a dermatologist.

lead: Skincaremaxxing means pursuing the best possible skin through a consistent routine and well-chosen products, as one component of looksmaxxing. Skin is judged alongside facial structure, so people treat it as one of the more accessible places to improve how they look.

The core routine described in Wikipedia's Skin care article is cleansing, moisturising and sun protection. Cleansers lift dirt, oil and dead skin, moisturisers reduce dryness and may strengthen the skin barrier, and sunscreen protects against UV damage that causes sunburn, early ageing and skin cancer risk [1]. The same article says that dermatological consensus favours a basic routine, with other products used for specific conditions like acne [1].

On looksmax.org the term appears in the context of broader plans; one thread has a user posting facial morphs they hope to reach with skincaremaxxing plus a jaw implant, and replies critique the results [2].

chain: Cleanse, moisturise and protect from the sun consistently
Fewer dry, irritated or sun-damaged areas
angle.text: A daily routine of cleansing, moisturising and sunscreen aims at hydrated, less irritated skin and less sun damage, which people count as part of overall facial attractiveness.

paras: Wikipedia describes cleansers as using surfactants, with synthetic detergent cleansers generally milder than traditional alkaline soaps, and describes exfoliation as mechanical or chemical, noting that overdoing it can cause irritation and barrier damage [1]. Moisturisers use humectants, occlusives or emollients and applying one twice daily may strengthen the skin barrier [1]. Sunscreen is applied before exposure and reapplied after sweating or swimming, with non-comedogenic formulas for oily skin and unscented ones for sensitive skin [1].

Skincare is commonly treated as a baseline step alongside other approaches, and users on looksmax.org mention it in the same breath as surgical options such as jaw implants [2]. Terms like cosmeceutical are described as marketing language without a scientific definition in U.S. law [1].

No studies found on skincaremaxxing as a combined practice. Trials exist on individual products, such as a moisturiser containing niacinamide and glycerin that reduced dryness more than versions without niacinamide [1].
